'''Barden Golah''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]].

==Biography==
Golah previously ran expeditions on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], [[Malachor II]] and [[Nim Drovis]].<ref name="TOR" /> He was later leading an [[Reclamation Service Tatooine expedition|expedition]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] along with [[Darth Silthar]] to find an artifact in a [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] dig site taken over by a mad [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] named [[the Imprisoned One]].

[[File:Barden_Golah_on_Dantooine.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Barden Golah on Dantooine]]
Golah was later promoted to the rank of [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] and sent to investigate the [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] [[Jedi Enclave]], where he encountered [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]], [[Arn Peralun]], and [[Aryn Leneer]]. Despite being defeated by the Commander's party, he escaped the encounter after [[Darth Malgus]] interrupted the battle with his trap.<ref name="Secrets">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Secrets of the Enclave}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Barden Golah appears as a boss in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] expansion. In the expansion, Golah only appears in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] story, given that his role is replaced by [[Leeha Narezz]] in the Imperial version of the story.<ref name="Secrets" />

In the Imperial story, Golah will appear at a number of points during the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith|''Legacy of the Sith'']] expansion, including at the ruins of the [[Temple of Nul]] on [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]] following the defeat of Darth Malgus, where he will help uncover [[Darth Nul]]'s connection to the [[Children of the Emperor]]. If the player previously met him during his mission on Tatooine, they can experience unique dialogue with him.<ref name="LotS">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''</ref>
